cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(zelda_physics LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_ALL_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GENERATE_DEBUG_SYMBOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DEBUG_RENDERER_IN_DEBUG_AND_RELEASE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PROFILER_IN_DEBUG_AND_RELEASE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_OBJECT_STREAM OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(../JoltPhysics/Build Jolt EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set_target_properties(Jolt PROPERTIES
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
)
add_library(zelda_physics SHARED physics.cpp)
target_include_directories(zelda_physics PRIVATE ../JoltPhysics)
target_link_libraries(zelda_physics PRIVATE Jolt)
set_target_properties(zelda_physics PROPERTIES
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    INSTALL_NAME_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_NAME_DIR ON
    WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON
)
